title: CSS Modules
description: Scoped CSS classes that avoid global naming conflicts.

data.text: CSS Modules are a CSS file where all class and animation names are scoped locally by default. They compile to unique class names, preventing global style conflicts without requiring BEM or other naming conventions.

data.title: Using CSS Modules in React
data.content: Import a CSS Module and use the scoped class names.

data.title: Why CSS Modules?
data.text: CSS Modules automatically generate unique class names, so you never have naming conflicts between components.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: CSS Modules scope class names locally
No global style leaks between components
Works with any bundler that supports CSS imports
data.takeaway: CSS Modules provide the simplicity of CSS with the safety of scoped styles.
